text_block_list.text:
Here I stand. Here we shine. Across eons,
at fate's end, myriad
threads entwined as
one.
Hark, hark! Flames, guests, Goddesses!
Tonight, hark and bear witness.

As we carry the Heartfire hence, and bear
it thither.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, did you hear? At this year's
Fleetfoot Festival, they're
gonna do the
Heartfire Ceremony for the first time in
forever!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The Heartfire Ceremony? You mean the
event where they, like, write
the wishes of
retired runners on sole slates and chuck
them in a bonfire?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you believe the rumors,
apparently they're gonna choose
Tracen students to
be the Heartfire Bearers who carry out the
 ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: For real? Isn't it supposed to be, like, super good luck to be a Bearer? I'd kill for that. I'm gonna need all the luck I can get for my next race!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude! I thank you all for assembling
here in spite of your busy
schedules!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day you get called up by
the director herself. And for
some reason, I'm
seein' a whole lotta familiar faces
here...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Welp, that means we don't gotta waste
time on introductions. So
wazzup? What
can we do ya for?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Attention! As you may already know, this
year's Fleetfoot Festival
will, for the first
time in years, feature the Heartfire
Ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A chance to honor the hopes and dreams
of our forerunners before the Three
Goddesses. A ritual of, by, and for
Umamusume—is that
right?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Correct! The Entwinement and the
Procession—these two rites together make
up this most dynamic, mystical, and
time-honored of
ceremonies!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This time, the Heartfire Bearers in charge
of the ceremony will be
none other than...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross! Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Inari One! Mejiro Ardan! Yaeno Muteki!
You five have been chosen!

Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe it!
You would trust us with
such momentous
responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is an honor. So the rumors that the
Bearers would be chosen from
among the
student body were true, then.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, you five will soon attend an
intensive training camp to
prepare for the
ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! As you will be
representing Tracen Academy—and, dare I
say, every Umamusume running today—it
is my sincere wish that you spare NO
effort!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm pretty sure the Heartfire
Ceremony happens on top of a mountain,
so ya think we oughta pick up some bug
spray or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
let's grab the stuff we use at
summer camp. ...Hey Oguri, whazza
matter? Havin' a starin' contest with the
snacks?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was just wondering how much food
we need to bring.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dis a field trip to you?! Geez...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That aside, I'm surprised all us chums
managed to get picked. Don't they decide
it through some kinda divination? We win
the lottery or
what?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we're all together. I don't know
what exactly a Heartfire
Bearer does, but I got chosen for it,
so I'll be the best Bearer
I can be.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And as long as I'm with you guys, I have a
feeling things'll work out somehow. So us
all being chosen together makes me feel

reassured—and glad.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! There's our Honest Oguri!
Handpicked for a big role and still
got
that goofy look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Never gonna change, are ya... Well, it is
reassurin', I'll agree with you
on that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They say it's good luck, so I was half
hopin' I'd get to be a Bearer anyways. And
now that we're doin' it, we gotta be the
best there ever
was!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This boot camp, though... I hope the food
there is good.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dis a vacation to you?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What did your grandmother have to say?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Perform your duty well," was the gist of
it,
apparently. Her words
have hardened my
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that may be so, but it seems to me
they've also lightened your mood. At
least,
that's what your prancing tail would
suggest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That... Well,
it is... embarrassing to admit,
but as much as I am honored to receive
this role, and look forward to this 
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume, and as a disciple of
the Kongo Yaegaki school, what I look
forward to most of all is the chance to
make my
grandparents proud.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...But that aside, I could say much the
same about you. It appears to
me you're
feeling rather giddy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You're quite right—I feel equal parts
honored and excited. For
our training
camp with the others, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a wonderful time, followed by a
Heartfire Ceremony for the
history
books—our hard work will make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, certainly.
